description: One-click install of the MorWebsite MCP engine (MoribundMurdoch/mor-website-editor-mcp). Opt-in Robot Assist; editor stays offline otherwise.
Automatically toggles dark mode based on the user's OS preference.
A header bell that opens a dropdown previewing your newest post. Colors follow the active theme.
Export mor-theme.css and rsync the project to any SSH host (Hostinger defaults available).
